selector.champion: Tetralogy of Fallot with pulmonary atresia
selector.rationale: The presence of pulmonary atresia with ventricular septal defect and a patent ductus arteriosus strongly supports Tetralogy of Fallot with pulmonary atresia, which is a more specific diagnosis than Alagille syndrome for these cardiac findings.

rejected.label: Congenital thrombocytopenia
rejected.why: A provisional diagnosis of immune thrombocytopenia was made, which contradicts congenital thrombocytopenia.

rejected.label: Jacobsen syndrome
rejected.why: While platelet aggregation time was prolonged, Jacobsen syndrome is not directly supported by the vignette's focus on cardiac issues and thrombocytopenia without clear mention of other syndrome-specific features.

rejected.label: Thrombocytopenia-absent radius syndrome
rejected.why: There is no mention of absent radius, a key feature of this syndrome, making it an unlikely diagnosis.
